drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Thank you. We propose serving amended, request-by-request responses within seven calendar days of this letter, with production and any required privilege log completed within twenty-one calendar days of this letter. Each amended response will specify any objection and its basis and state whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Please confirm agreement to that schedule.

The amended responses will confirm that production encompasses all responsive, nonprivileged documents within Defendant’s possession, custody, or control identified following a reasonable search, except to the extent expressly identified in a request-specific objection. Any disputed scope limitation will be identified for discussion, rather than left implicit in a general objection. Defendant will supplement as required by the applicable rules.

The prior draft’s reference to an attached privilege log was incorrect; no log accompanied it. Any privilege withholding will be addressed in the log served on the proposed production deadline, subject to applicable rules and any agreed logging protocol.

edits.text: 1. OBJECTIONS. Objections will be stated separately for each request, with their specific bases and a statement whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Defendant does not assert a blanket privilege objection to every request. Any applicable claim of attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or other protection will be identified in the response to the affected request.
edits.name: Specific objections and withholding disclosures

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Following a reasonable search, Defendant will produce all responsive, nonprivileged documents within its possession, custody, or control, except to the extent expressly identified in a request-specific objection. Each such response will identify any limitation on the scope of the search or production and state whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Defendant proposes serving amended request-specific responses within seven calendar days of the accompanying letter and completing production within twenty-one calendar days of that letter.
edits.name: Production scope and proposed deadlines

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. No privilege log accompanies this response. To the extent responsive materials are withheld on privilege or protection grounds, Defendant proposes serving a log by the production deadline stated above, in accordance with the applicable rules and any agreed logging protocol. If no responsive materials are withheld on those grounds, Defendant will state that expressly.
edits.name: Correct privilege-log representation

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement or correct its responses and production as required by the applicable rules.
edits.name: Affirmative supplementation obligation
